locator: Fig. 5, ibuprofen-sensitive currents with 1 mM lactate and without lactate, at negative voltages
preparation: Human SMCT1 expressed in a Xenopus oocyte, 96 mM external sodium, approximately 24 °C, pH 7.6. The two plotted series come from one representative voltage-clamp experiment.
mapping: At each voltage subtract the ibuprofen-sensitive substrate-free current from the ibuprofen-sensitive current with lactate. Inward electrical current is negative. The reading precision is approximate. The figure supplies no per-point biological uncertainty. Intracellular activities and the microscopic rate and charge assignments are not measured in this experiment.
